title: Full Auto - Perfectus
features:
**Anime Dice | Perfectus** — Feature list (Open Source)

### Main
- Auto Collect Money
- Collect Delay (slider, e.g. 3.0 s)
- Auto Rebirth
- Rebirth Check (slider, e.g. 5.0 s)
- Rebirth Now
- Auto Roll
- Auto Hide Rolls
- Auto Claim Quests
- Claim Quests Now
- Auto Redeem Codes
- Redeem Retry (slider, e.g. 300 s)
- Redeem All Codes Now

### Units
- Auto Level Up
- Max Unit Level (slider, e.g. 41)
- Smart Level Cap
- Level Delay (slider, e.g. 0.1 s)
- Auto Place Best
- Replace Worst When Full
- Place Check (slider, e.g. 3.0 s)
- Game’s EquipBest (one-shot)

### Upgrades
- Auto Upgrades
- Upgrade Delay (slider, e.g. 5.0 s)
- Category Filter (dropdown, e.g. Various)

### Dice
- Auto Buy Best Dice
- Auto Equip Best Dice
- Dice Check (slider, e.g. 5.0 s)

### Sell
- Rarity Threshold (e.g. 15qd)
- Set Threshold
- Smart Sell Threshold
- Apply Threshold To Game
- Auto Instant Sell
- Sell Check (slider, e.g. 5.0 s)
- Keep Top N (slider, e.g. 0)
- Sell Now (below threshold)

### Tower
- Tower (dropdown, e.g. Infinity Tower [Infinity])
- Auto Towers
- Equip Best Tower Team
- Smart Tower (auto pick) — *Picks the highest tower your team can clear. Excludes Infinity.*
- Stop Tower
- Tower Wins (counter)
- Tower Steps (counter)
- Tower Floor (counter)

### Potion
- Auto Potion
- Potions (dropdown, e.g. Various)
- Best Per Category — *Uses the highest owned tier per category. Lower tiers would be wasted, since only the highest tier per category applies in-game.*
- Extend While Active — *If on, re-uses the same potion before it expires and extends its duration. If off, waits for expiry.*
- Potion Check (slider, e.g. 5.0 s)
- Use Now (selected)
- Show Active
- Refresh List (show counts)

### Reroll
**Auto Grade**
- Auto Grade
- Target Grades (dropdown, e.g. Various)
- Grade Units (dropdown, e.g. None)
- Refresh Grade Units
- Grade: All Units
- Grade: Placed Units Only — *Only reroll units currently placed on slots, ignore idle inventory units.*
- Grade Delay (slider, e.g. 0.1 s)
- Grade: Gems Reserve

**Auto Trait**
- Auto Trait
- Target Traits (dropdown, e.g. Various)
- Trait Units (dropdown, e.g. None)
- Refresh Trait Units
- Trait: All Units
- Trait: Placed Units Only — *Only reroll units currently placed on slots, ignore idle inventory units.*
- Trait Delay (slider, e.g. 0.1 s)
- Trait: Trait Reroll Reserve

### Trade
- Auto Trade
- Min Money (e.g. 1b)
- Set Min Money
- Retries Per Player (slider, e.g. 1)
- Hop When Empty
- Auto Ready + Accept
- Require Partner Offer
- Min Partner Items (slider, e.g. 0)
- Trade Webhook URL
- Trade Alerts
- Stop + Cancel Trade

### Webhook
- Roll Webhook URL
- Roll Alerts
- Roll Min Chance (e.g. 50t)
- Stat Webhook URL
- Stat Reports
- Stat Report Interval (slider, e.g. 60 s)
